name: agience-server-sage
description: Hybrid search and evidence-backed retrieval over the platform's own index.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Lexical BM25 search across workspaces and collections

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Search this node's corpus and rank by what the question is about, not by term overlap. Returns only artifacts the caller may read.

tools.name: web_retrieve
tools.description: Fetch a web page or paper by URL, extract clean text, and persist it as a text/markdown artifact in the given workspace (stamped with operator provenance and the source URL)

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Fetch a card by ID. Returns full card content and context

tools.name: browse_collections
tools.description: List committed collections accessible to the current user

tools.name: search_azure
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule: retrieval runs on the platform's own index. Use the `search` tool

tools.name: index_to_azure
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule: source-of-truth and the retrieval index both stay in the platform

tools.name: research
tools.description: Multi-step grounded research: (1) search the corpus via the retrieval organon (mantle FTS under the caller's grants), (2) deepen each hit by fetching its full content, (3) assemble a budgeted…

tools.name: cite_sources
tools.description: Produce a provenance receipt for a synthesised answer: for each cited card, fetch it under the caller's delegation and record id, title, content type, content length and content sha256 (the…

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question with optional card context: grounds the question via the retrieval organon (mantle FTS under the caller's grants) and/or the given cards, and returns {answer, citations, refusal} —…

tools.name: extract_information
tools.description: Extract structured fields from a card's content, deterministically: JSON content is read by key; text content is scanned for 'field: value' lines matching the schema's property names

tools.name: generate_meeting_insights
tools.description: Raises. Meeting summarization awaits a grounded summarization operator; the model leg is barred by the no-models rule. Use `ask` or `research` against the transcript card

resources.description: Browse committed artifacts in a collection

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface.
